lifecycles.name: work_item

states.label: Backlog
states.description: Filed, but not yet judged unblocked, grounded and routed. Routines do not take it. A reopened item returns here.

states.label: Ready
states.description: Unblocked, grounded and routed to a lane: one member may claim it. The routines' work queue.

states.label: In progress
states.description: Claimed by one member, who is working it. Nobody else starts it while the claim stands. A stop for a human's input keeps the claim and adds the needs-input hold.

states.label: In review
states.description: A pull request that closes it is open. It is not claimable while that pull request is open, including while review asks for changes.

states.label: Done
states.description: Closed: completed (landed, or no code was needed) or not planned (dropped or superseded).

transitions.name: promote
transitions.description: Judged unblocked, grounded and routed. Any member may request it; the clerk makes it.

transitions.name: claim
transitions.description: One member claims it through the clerk.

transitions.name: claim-unfed
transitions.description: The owner's session or a group builder claims an item the feed never promoted.

transitions.name: open-pr
transitions.description: A pull request that closes it is open.

transitions.name: reclaim
transitions.description: The claim went quiet past the stale-claim window, with no open closing pull request and no needs-input hold.

transitions.name: pr-closed-unmerged
transitions.description: Its pull request closed without merging and no other is open.

transitions.name: merge
transitions.description: A merged pull request closed it.

transitions.name: close-backlog
transitions.description: Closed by hand, not by a merged pull request: no code was needed, not planned, or superseded.

transitions.name: close-ready
transitions.description: Closed by hand, not by a merged pull request: no code was needed, not planned, or superseded.

transitions.name: close-in-progress
transitions.description: Closed by hand, not by a merged pull request: no code was needed, not planned, or superseded.

transitions.name: close-in-review
transitions.description: Closed by hand, not by a merged pull request: no code was needed, not planned, or superseded.

transitions.name: reopen
transitions.description: Reopened; it is judged again before it is fed.

lifecycles.description: Where a work item is in the flow, from filing to done. Position only: what stops an item is a hold (work_hold), and a hold never moves the position. How a programme shows each state (board column, label) is its own data: label-binding records that bind to these states.

vocabularies.name: work_label

terms.label: Promote request
terms.description: Asks for the promote transition; board-sync makes it.

terms.label: Bug
terms.description: Something does not work. Bugs ride their own track, never the Ready feed, and are never weaker than P1.

terms.label: Epic
terms.description: A tracking item whose sub-issues are the work.

terms.label: Plan
terms.description: A design brief, not a work item.

terms.label: User story
terms.description: A user-facing story that work serves.

terms.label: Unattended lane
terms.description: Routines may run it without the owner present.

terms.label: Priority P0
terms.description: Derived priority P0; never set by hand.

terms.label: Priority P1
terms.description: Derived priority P1; never set by hand.

terms.label: Priority P2
terms.description: Derived priority P2; never set by hand.

terms.label: Size small
terms.description: Effort estimate: small.

terms.label: Size medium
terms.description: Effort estimate: medium.

terms.label: Size large
terms.description: Effort estimate: large.

terms.label: Size xl
terms.description: Effort estimate: xl.

terms.label: Critical path
terms.description: On the critical path of a ranked change: raises derived priority one tier.

terms.label: Blocks a gate
terms.description: Blocks a gate: raises derived priority one tier.

terms.label: Regression
terms.description: Something that worked broke: raises derived priority one tier.

terms.label: No code
terms.description: Closed as completed with no code change.

terms.label: Desk
terms.description: The owner's desk item.

terms.label: Review requested
terms.description: The owner asks the group reviewer to look at a pull request again.

vocabularies.description: What a work item or pull request is, or who takes it: classification, never position or hold. Also the request that asks for promotion. A working group's own label is its charter's group_label, not a term here.

vocabularies.name: merge_gate

terms.label: Auto-merge
terms.description: Merges itself once every gate is green: mode clear or complicated, and Door 1 or non-normative. In a working group only its reviewer sets it, with the quorum.

terms.label: Owner merge
terms.description: Held for the owner to merge: mode complex, Door 2 or 3, a new dependency, a user-visible product change, or anything the builder is unsure of.

vocabularies.description: How a pull request may merge. One per gated pull request. The rules for which applies are the owner's (a8bc55ef).

vocabularies.name: work_hold

terms.label: Needs input
terms.description: Stopped at a question only a human can answer; the question is in the comments. Set by the member who stops; a human answers and clears it.

terms.label: Blocked
terms.description: Waiting on other work. Derived from blocked-by edges when there are any; set and cleared by hand only for a block outside the tracker, such as a spec RFC not yet accepted.

terms.label: Parked
terms.description: Serves no ranked objective in the active period. It returns when a period ranks it, or when ranked work depends on it.

vocabularies.description: What stops a work item from being fed, claimed or built, whatever its position (work_item). An item that carries any of these is held; removing it lets the item go on from where it was. An assignee or an open pull request is not a hold: it is a position.
